title: Usps Metric1 High Value Outliers
dataSources: Move checklists (`move:checklist`), USPS change-of-address (`usps:change`), mover quotes (`mover:quote`), utility transfers (`utility:transfer`), and box inventories (`box:inventory`).
app: Move checklist task exports, USPS change-of-address confirmations, mover quote comparisons, utility transfer logs, and box inventory scans forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=usps:metric1 value=*
| eventstats perc90(value) as p90, perc10(value) as p10
| where value>=p90 OR value<=p10
| table _time source_id value p90 p10
description: Surfaces the highest and lowest value outliers in usps metric1 (1) events.
value: Tail events often explain spikes in cost, effort, or risk that averages hide.
implementation: Compute percentile bands on `value` and review extreme usps metric1 (1) records.
visualization: Scatter plot of value with percentile bands.
grandmaExplanation: It scans the unusually high or low value moments in your usps metric1 (1) history.
